features.name: Payment Integration Best Practices
features.description: Implement payment integration best practices including idempotency keys, webhook verification, retry logic, error handling, and monitoring

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform developer, I want payment integration to follow best practices, so that the system is reliable, secure, and maintainable.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses idempotency keys for all payment requests to prevent duplicates
Implements webhook endpoints for payment status updates
Verifies webhook signatures to prevent spoofing
Implements retry logic for failed webhook deliveries
Polls payment status as backup when webhooks fail
Handles duplicate webhook events gracefully
Logs all payment-related events for debugging and audit
Queues payments and retries when payment gateway is unavailable
Displays user-friendly error messages for payment failures
Provides alternative payment methods when primary method fails
Tests all payment flows in gateway sandbox environments before production
Monitors payment gateway API health and response times
Implements circuit breaker pattern for gateway failures
Caches payment method tokens securely with encryption at rest

features.name: Super-App Performance Optimization
features.description: Optimize Mini-Program and super-app integration performance with code splitting, lazy loading, caching, and monitoring

requirementDetails.userStory: As a WeChat or Grab user, I want fast loading times and smooth performance, so that the rental experience feels native to the super-app.
acceptanceCriteria: Optimizes Mini-Program initial load time (under 3 seconds)
Implements code splitting and lazy loading
Minimizes API calls to reduce latency
Caches frequently accessed data locally
Optimizes images and assets for mobile networks
Implements progressive loading for content
Monitors performance metrics (load time, API response time)
Optimizes for low-bandwidth scenarios
Implements efficient state management
Conducts regular performance testing and optimization
